author: lukebrady81
quote: I find Jason to be an incredibly dull character. Furthermore, I am not interested in life simulations. If I want to perform mundane daily tasks like painting, eating, showering, socializing with my girlfriend, or texting, I would rather do them in real life. When I play a video game, I prefer a fantasy experience instead. I have encountered several bugs that have significantly negatively impacted my experience, but more importantly, the frame rate frequently dropping below 30 FPS causes me physical discomfort, as I am quite sensitive to it. This level of performance is unacceptable for a game that was in development for thirteen years.
